```bash
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

settings_path = Path(os.environ["SETTINGS_PATH"])
setting_key = os.environ["SETTING_KEY"]
raw_setting_value = os.environ["SETTING_VALUE"]
if raw_setting_value not in ("true", "false"):
    raise AssertionError("The VS Code user setting value must be true or false")
setting_value = raw_setting_value == "true"
settings_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if settings_path.exists():
    settings = json.loads(settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
else:
    settings = {}
if not isinstance(settings, dict):
    raise AssertionError("VS Code user settings must contain a JSON object")
settings[setting_key] = setting_value
settings_path.write_text(json.dumps(settings, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
persisted = json.loads(settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if persisted.get(setting_key) is not setting_value:
    raise AssertionError("The VS Code user setting was not persisted")
PY
```
